<entry id="J00696">
<head-word>יָשֵׁן, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. אֲשַׁן)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to recover strength</italic>, cmp. חָלַם,] 
<italic>to sleep</italic>, trnsf. 
<italic>to be idle, lazy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. III, 5 (I swear) שאִישַׁן that I will sleep, שיָשַׁנְתִּי that I have slept. Num. R. s. 20 בא לִישָׁן going to sleep.—Cant. R. to III, 1 ישנתי לי מן התירה וכ' I (Israel) have been lazy in the study of the Law and the performance of good deeds; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00697">
<head-word>יָשֵׁן, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>asleep, inactive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. LIX הקב"ה עושה עצמו כביכול י' the Lord sometimes pretends, if it were permitted to say so, to be asleep; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. יְשֵׁנִים, יְשֵׁנִין, יְשֵי'</plural-form>. Num. R. s. 20 הרי הן י' מן וכ' they are sluggish in study &c., v. preced. Cant. R. to VII, 10 י' במערת וכ' sleeping in the cave of Makhpelah. Ex. R. s. 1; a. fr.—Fem. יְשֵׁנָה, יְשֵׁי'. Midr. Till. to Ps. CX, beg. (ref. to Is. XLI, 2) הצדקה היתה י' וכ' Righteousness was asleep and Abraham waked her up. Cant. R. to V, 2 אני י' מן וכ' I (Israel) was lazy &c., v. supra; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00698">
<head-word>יָשַׁן</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> cmp. preced. wds. a.
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> אֵיתָן)</xref></language-reference>
<italic>to be strong, hard, old</italic> (cmp. קשיש).</definition>
<notes>—V. יוֹשֶׁן a. next w.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>יִישֵּׁן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to let grow old</italic> (
<italic>strong</italic>), 
<italic>keep, reserve</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 91
<sup>b</sup> דברים שדרכן ליַישְּׁנָן things which it is customary to keep (to store, as wine &c.). Deut. R. s. 9, beg. מן היין הזה אני מְיַישֵּׁן וכ' of this wine I will store away a portion for my son’s wedding. Tosef. Ab. Zar. VIII (IX), 3 צריך ליַשֵּׁן he must store them away (leave them unused); Tosef. Toh. XI, 16. Ib. כמה הוא מְיַשְּׁנָן, v. יִשּׁוּן; Y. Ab. Zar. V, end 45
<sup>b</sup> מְיַישְּׁנָן כל י"ב וכ' he must leave them unused for the whole twelve-month; Bab. ib. 75
<sup>a</sup>.—Part. pass. מְיוּשָּׁן 
<italic>stored up</italic>, v. infra. Y. B. Bath. VII, end, 15
<sup>c</sup>. Y. Gitt. III, end, 45
<sup>b</sup> ‘old’ means last year’s crop, מי' של וכ' ‘stored’ means three years old.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְיַשֵּׁן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be stored up, to improve with age</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra B’huck. ch. III; Yalk. Lev. 672 (ref. to ישן נושן, Lev. XXVI, 10) כל המִתְיַשֵּׁן יפה מחבירו the sort which is stored up is the better of its kind; B. Bath. l. c. [read with Ms. R.:] כל המְיוּשָּׁן יפה מחבירו. Y. Gitt. l. c. הדא אמרה דאי מתישן וכ' this intimates that if wine is sold as 
<italic>mithyashshen</italic> (fit for storage) the seller is responsible for three years. Sifra l. c. לרבות כל המִתְיַישְּׁנִים including all produces fit for storage (besides wine); Yalk. l. c. לרבות כל הדבר המיושן.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נוֹשָׁן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. B. Bath. l. c.; a e., v. 
<xref rid="A00083">next w.</xref></notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="J00699">
<head-word>יָשָׁן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>hard, dry; old, of last year</italic>, opp. חָדָשׁ.</definition>
<notes> Dem. IV, 7. B. Bath. 91
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. expl. י' נוֹשָׁן (Lev. XXVI, 10), v. preced. Ab. IV, 20 קנקן חדש מלא י' a new vessel full of old wine (a young man but learned). Ab. Zar. III, 9 ואם י' וכ' and if the oven is old (dried) &c.; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. יְשָׁנִים</plural-form>. Ib. 33
<sup>a</sup> י' ומזופפין old or pitched wine vessels. Yoma II, 4, v. חָדָשׁ. Lev. R. s. 2, v. חָדָשׁ; a. fr.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. יְשָׁנָה. Kidd. IV, 5, Num. R. s. 9, v. אַרְכִי I.—
<plural-form>Pl. יְשָׁנוֹת</plural-form>. Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV (V), 10 י' זפופות, v. supra; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00700">
<head-word>יָשַׁע</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> cmp. preced. wds.) [
<italic>to be strong, to recover</italic>.</definition>
<notes>]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוֹשִׁיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to assist, help, deliver</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 34
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to י̇ה̇וש̇ע̇, Num. XIII, 17) י֗ה֗ יוֹשִׁ֗יעֲ֗ךָ וכ' Yah save thee from &c. Meg. 14
<sup>a</sup> עתידה … שיושִׁיעַ וכ' my mother shall bear a son who will deliver Israel; Sot. 11
<sup>b</sup> שמוֹשִׁיעַ. Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 4 כשתּוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מאויבי when thou shalt have saved me from my enemies. Snh. 73
<sup>a</sup>, v. מוֹשִׁיעַ. Ber. IV, 4 הוֹשַׁע וכ' help, O Lord &c.; a. fr.—V. הוֹשַׁעְנָא.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נוֹשַׁע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be saved, released</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. l. c. אִוָּשֵׁעַ מן וכ' let me be delivered from my enemies, and I shall call the Lord the praised One. Tanḥ. Aḥǎré 12 (ref. to ויושע, Ex. XIV, 30) וַיִוָּשַׁע כתיב כביכול הוא נ' it may be read 
<italic>vayivvasha</italic> (and he was saved), He, as if it were, was delivered. Ib. בעוה"ז הייתם נוֹשָׁעִים ע"י ב"א in this world (the past) you were delivered through human agencies.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="J00701">
<head-word>*, </head-word>
<head-word>*יְשַׁף</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= נשף), 
<italic>Af</italic>.</definition>
<notes> אוֹשֵׁיף 
<italic>to blow, kindle</italic>. Sabb. 119
<sup>a</sup> מוֹשִׁיף נורא fanning the fire.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00702">
<head-word>יָשְׁפֵּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>Jaspis</italic>, Benjamin’s jewel in the highpriest’s breast-plate.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 38, end. Y. Kidd. I, 61
<sup>b</sup> top.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00703">
<head-word>יָשַׁר</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. אָשַׁר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be firm, strong, healthy; to be straight, right</italic>.</definition>
<notes> יִישַׁר כֹּחֲךָ or חֵילְךָ ‘may thy strength (health) be firm’, a phrase of approval and thanks. Sabb. 87
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. (play on אֲשֶׁר, Ex. XXXIV, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> י' כ' ששברת, be thanked for having broken (the tablets).</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 54 (play on וישרנה, I Sam. VI, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> י' חילכם; a. e.—(יֵשַׁר) יִישַׁר (sub. כחך) 
<italic>thanks! right!</italic></definition>
<notes> Ber. 42
<sup>b</sup>; Sabb. 53
<sup>a</sup>; Erub. 32
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Cmp. אַיְשַׁר.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>יִישֵּׁר, יִשֵּׁ'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to straighten, direct, to make firm</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 1 (ref. to יֵשֶׁר, I Chr. II, 18) זה כלב שיי' את עצמו that is Caleb who kept himself straight (did not yield to the rest of the spies). Num. R. s. 8 (ref. to Ps. L, 23 ושם דרך) המְיַישֵּׁר אורחותיו וכ' he who directs his ways straight (pays regard to his doings).—Part. pass. מְיוּשָּׁר, f. מְיוּשֶּׁרֶת. Pirké d’R. El. ch. X דרכי מי' לפני my way is levelled before me.—Meg. 18
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to יישרו, Prov. IV, 25) מְיוּשָּׁרִין הן אצל וכ' they remain firm with (in the memory of) &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="J00704">
<head-word>יְשַׁר</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>Targ. II Esth. VII, 9 יִישַׁר חילך (Var. יִשַּׁר). [Cant. R. to I, 4 ישריין, v. 
<xref rid="J00705">next w.</xref>]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְיַשַּׁר, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְיְשַׁר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be strengthened</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Deut. X, 2, v. אֲשַׁר.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="J00705">
<head-word>יָשָׁר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>firm, sound; straight, right, upright</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 49 אברהם זה י' מן היְשָׁרִים this Abraham is firmer than all the firm (angels); Yalk. ib. 82 אברהם זה י'; Midr. Till. to Ps. XI, 7 קודם לִישָׁרוֹ של עולם וכ' before they see the Right One of the world, they (the pious) 
<pgbrk id="pg602" />shall behold the faces of the firm (believers); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. יְשָׁרִים, יְשָׁרִין</plural-form>. Cant. R. to I, 4 מה ישריין רחמיך, [read as:] Yalk. ib. 982 מה ישרים וכ', expl. מה תקיפין וכ' how strong are thy mercies. Midr. Till. l. c. איזו כת … זו כת י' which is the highest class among those who will greet the countenance of the Divine Presence (in the hereafter)? The class of the firm believers. Ib. to Ps. XXV, 14 … בתחלה ואה"כ נתן לי' first the secret of the Lord is communicated to those who fear him (human beings), and then to the firm ones (the angels, cmp. יְצוּקִים s. v. יָצַק); Gen. R. s. 49; a. e.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. יְשָׁרָה, 
<italic>pl</italic>. יְשָׁרוֹת (sub בעיניו; with ref. to Deut. XII, 8) [
<italic>right in the eyes of the offerer</italic>,] 
<italic>free-will offerings</italic> (opp. חוֹבָה). Zeb. 114
<sup>a</sup> י' תקריבו וכ' free-will sacrifices you may offer (on the 
<italic>bamoth</italic>, v. בָּמָה), but no obligatory offerings; ib. 117
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. י' נינהו they belong to the class of free-will offerings. Ib. 118
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר 
<italic>the Book Yashar</italic>, a lost book (Josh. X, 13; II Sam. I, 18). Ab. Zar. 25
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Sot. I, end, 17
<sup>c</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00706">
<head-word>יַשְׁרָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>firm believer, upright man</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. II, 65
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Mic. VII, 4) י' דבהון וכ' the upright man among them is like thorns.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00707">
<head-word>יִשְׂרָאֵל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.)</language-key>
<pos> pr. n.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Israel</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> I. (Jacob), the patriarch. Gen. R. s. 68 י' סבא the patriarch I.</definition>
<notes> the patriarch I. (not the people); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> I., the people. Ber. 6
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—שונאי י' the enemies of Israel, often euphem. for 
<italic>Israel</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 32
<sup>a</sup> נתמוטטו … של ש' י' the feet of Israel would totter (in judgment); a. fr.—V. כְּנֶסֶת.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> י' (= בן י') 
<italic>an Israelite</italic>, a) one not belonging to the priestly or levitic tribe; b) 
<italic>a Jew</italic>, opp. נכרי, גוי.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. V, 8. Tosef. Kidd. V, 3; a. fr.—Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 5, sq. Ab. Zar. II, 6; a. fr.—בַּת י' 
<italic>an Israelitish woman</italic>. Tosef. l. c. 1; 3; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. יִשְׂרְאֵלוֹת</plural-form> (opp. to כַּהֲנוֹת, לְוִיּוֹת). Tosef. Snh. IV, 2.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00708">
<head-word>יִשְׂרְאֵלִי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>one belonging to a common Israelitish family</italic>, contrad. to כֹּהֲנִי, a. לְוִיִי.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. IV, 1; Yeb. 37
<sup>a</sup> (collective noun).—
<plural-form>Pl. יִשְׂרְאֵלִים</plural-form>. Ib. 85
<sup>a</sup>. Tosef. Ber. V, 14.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. יִשְׂרְאֵלִית 
<italic>an Israelitish</italic> (
<italic>Jewish</italic>) 
<italic>woman</italic>. Nidd. IV, 2 (33
<sup>b</sup>) (collective noun, opp. to כותיות).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00709">
<head-word>יַשְׁרוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="J00250">יוֹשֶׁר</xref> a. 
<xref rid="A00083">יָשָׁר)</xref>
<italic>firmness, faith, right conduct, equity</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Meg. I, 72
<sup>c</sup> top (ref. to Deut. XII, 8, cmp. יָשָׁר) ומה תעשו שם דבר שהוא בא לידי י' וכ' and what dare you do there (on the 
<italic>bamah</italic>)? An act by which one is led towards faith, which is burnt-offerings and peace-offerings. Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIX, 4 (ref. to מישרים ib.) אתה כוננת י' של עולם (ed. Bub. י' בעולמך) thou hast established the firmness of thy world (through courts of justice); Yalk. Ps. 852 י' בעולמך.—Gen. R. s. 54 (ref. to וישרנה, I Sam. VI, 12) מהלכות בי' they walked with propriety (paying reverence to the Ark; Midr. Sam. ch. XII ביופי). Ruth R. introd. 3 (ref. to ישר, Prov. XXI, 8) במדת י' in fairness; ib. בי'; Yalk. Prov. 959. Deut. R. s. 8 היא וכל כלי אומנתה ניתנה … יַשְׁרוּתָה she (the Torah) and all her implements have been given to man, her humility, her righteousness and her fairness.—Sot. 9
<sup>b</sup>, v. next w.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00710">
<head-word>יַשְׁרוּתָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>(v. 
<xref rid="J00709">preced.</xref>) 
<italic>that which seems right, arbitrary will</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 9
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Jud. XIV, 3 ישרה בעיני) כי אזל מיהא בתר יַשְׁרוּתֵיה אזל when he (Samson) went out (to marry), he, at all events, followed only his own liking (not the will of the Lord); [marginal version יַשְׁרוּת עיניו]; Yalk. Jud. 69.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00711">
<head-word>יַת</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="A01639">אִית</xref>) [
<italic>being, existence</italic>,] a particle </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> indicating the objective case (= h. אֵת).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. I, 1; a. v. fr.—With pronominal suffixes: יָתִי 
<italic>me</italic>, יָתָךְ, יָתִיךְ 
<italic>thee</italic> &c. Targ. Deut. IV, 14. Targ. Gen. XII, 12. Ib. L, 21; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (with pronominal suffix of the third person) 
<italic>he himself, this one</italic> &c. Y. Bicc. III, 65
<sup>d</sup> top אמר יָתֵיה דמן רבנן said he (who was before mentioned as) one of the scholars. Gen. R. s. 9, beg.; Koh. R. to III, 11, a. e. יַתְהוֹן those (opp. to דין), v. 
<xref rid="E00674">הֲנִי</xref>.</definition>
<notes>—With prepositional prefix: וַת, v. כְּוָת, לְוָת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00712">
<head-word>יתֵב, </head-word>
<head-word>יְתֵיב, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key> ch. = h.</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="J00675">יָשַׁב</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , 
<italic>to sit, dwell</italic> &c.; 
<italic>to be inhabited, settled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXXVI, 7 מִיתַּב ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. מֵיתַב). Targ. O. Ex. XVI, 35 יָתֵיבְתָּא (Y. מֵיתִיבָא)

<sense>

<plural-form>Pl. נוֹתָרִים, נוֹתָרוֹת</plural-form>. Sifré Aḥăré Par. 5, ch. VII.—Cant. R. to V, 14 כמה נ' how many laws about

<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוֹתִיר</binyan-form>

<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>

<italic>to add; to do too much</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 13
<sup>a</sup> שמא אתה … מְיַיתֵּר for if thou omit one letter or write one too many; Sot. 20
<sup>a</sup> תַּתִּיר

Yithro 4 his name was Jether (Jethro) שֶׁיִּ' פרשה וכ' because he gave rise to an additional chapter (about judges) in the Law; Mekh. ib., Amalek, s. 1 שהוֹתִיר.—Ib. שיי' במעשים טובים because he did more (than ordinary men, was liberal in) good deeds. <sup>b</sup> וייתר, v. יָתַר.]—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְיוּתָּר, 
<italic>pl</italic>. מְיוּתָּרִין 
<italic>added, superfluous</italic>. Koh. R. to V, 8 (ref. to ויתרון, ib.) דברים שתראה (ש)הן מי' לתורה (not בתורה) things which thou wouldst regard as additions to the Law. Ib. אפי' דברים … מי' בעולם even things in nature which thou wouldst believe to be superfluous (useless); Ex. R. s. 10; (Gen. R. s. 10 יְתֵירָה); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sense>

<italic>here; now</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. IV, 7
<sup>c</sup> bot., a. e. כ' נתפלל וכ' here (in this inn) did my father say the prayer of &c. Bets. IV, 7 מִכַּ' ועד כ' from here to there (will I use). Ber. I, 2, a. fr. מכ' ואילך, v. אֵילֵךְ. Snh. IX, 1 ולאחר מכ' and subsequently; a. fr.—מכ' אמרו (חכמים) from this originates what the scholars said. Ab. I, 5; a. fr.—מִכַּ' ל־, מִכַּ' ש־ from this is derived, do we learn. Ber. 64

<sup>a</sup> מכ' שצדיקים אומרים וכ' from this we see that the righteous promise little &c.; a. fr.—כ' … כ' here (in this case) …, there (in another place, in that case). Succ. 44
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.—Contr. כַּן, with pref. מ, מִיכַּן. Y. Ber. IV, 7
<sup>c</sup> top [read:] כן ליחיד כן לציבור in this case (when Levi disfavored many prayers), it is meant for individuals, in the other case, it is meant for congregations.—Y. Erub. VII, 24
<sup>b</sup> bot. מ' ומ' on both sides; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00030">
<head-word>כָּבֵד, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to be heavy, weighty, important</italic>; cmp. יָקַר.</definition>

<binyan-form>כִּבֵּר, כִּי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to honor, hold precious</italic>;
<italic> to show honor.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. IV, 1 איזהו מכובד המְכַבֵּד וכ' who will be honored? He who honors men. Sabb. 113
<sup>b</sup> ר"י קרי למאניה מְכַבְּדוֹתַי Rabbi Joh. called his garments ‘my honorers’; B. Kam. 91
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 94
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Ber. 46
<sup>b</sup> bot. אין מְכַבְּדִין וכ' we must not show honors (saying, ‘you go first’) on highroads &c. Part. pass. מְכוּבָּד, pl. מְכוּבָּדִים, מְכוּבָּדִין. Ab. l. c., v. supra. Ib. 6 כל המכבד … גופו מ' על וכ' he who honors the Law, will himself be honored of men. Ber. 60
<sup>b</sup>, v. infra. Ab. Zar. III, 3, v. בָּזָה; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. אִיקְרָא, יְקַר) 
<italic>to offer a gift</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vayḥi 13 שמְכַבְּדִין מפירותיהם וכ' they offer of their fruits to kings; Gen. R. s. 99, end והם מבכרין (corr. acc.); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to make look respectable</italic>,] 
<italic>to sweep, adjust the room</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. VIII, 4 מכבדיו את הבית וכ' (after meal) the room is put in order (the crumbs swept), and then &c. Bets. II, 7 (22
<sup>b</sup>) מכבדין בין המטות (Bab. ed. בית המטות) (on Holy Days) you may sweep between the dining couches (the dining room); Y. 
<pgbrk id="pg607" />ib. II, 61
<sup>c</sup> bot. Tam. V, 5 היה מְכַבְּדָן לאמה one swept them (the coals) into the duct; a. fr.—Mikv. VIII, 4 כִּיבְּדָֹה את, הבית, v. בַּיִת 6.—[Ruth R. end וכבד some ed., read: וכָבַר.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְכַּבֵּד, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְכַּבֵּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be honored; to pride, exalt one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 1 כל המִתְכַּבֵּד בקלון וכ' whoever elevates himself at the expense of his neighbor’s degradation, has no share in the world to come; Y. Ḥag. II, 77
<sup>c</sup>. Meg. 28
<sup>a</sup> מימי לא נִתְכַּבַּדְתִּי וכ' I never elevated myself &c. Ber. 60
<sup>b</sup> הִתְכַּבְּדוּ מכובדים be in honor dismissed, you honored ones (angels); a. e.—2) 
<italic>to be cleaned, swept; to be dressed, adorned</italic>. Pes. 7

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<italic>pressed, compressed; pressing</italic>. Ib. 135

IX, 4 כאילו אבנים כְּבוּשׁוֹת וכ' as if stones were placed tightly upon them. Ex. R. s. 15 ההר … כְּבוּשִׁין על וכ' a mountain on each side pressing upon (preventing the run of) the springs; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> כ' פנים (בקרקע) 
<italic>to press the face</italic> into the ground, to 
<italic>hide one’s self</italic> in fear or shame.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 19
<sup>b</sup> כָּבְשׁוּ פניהם בקרקע they cast their looks down (were afraid to give an opinion). Y. ib. X, 27
<sup>d</sup> (ref. to Is. VII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition> א"ת כובס אלא כּוֹבֵשׁ שהיה כובש פניו וכ' read not 
<italic>kobes</italic>, but 
<italic>kobesh</italic>, for he hid his face and fled before him; (Bab. ib. 104
<sup>a</sup> דכבשינהו לאפי Chald.</definition>
<notes>).—3) 
<italic>to press vegetables, meat </italic>&c
<italic>.</italic>;
<italic> to preserve, pickle.</italic> Toh. II, 1 האשה … כּוֹבֶשֶׁת וכ' if a woman was pressing vegetables in a pot. Ukts. II, 1 זתים שכְּבָשָׁן וכ' olives which one pressed with their leaves; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּבוּשׁ 
<italic>preserved substance, pickle</italic>. Ḥull 97
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. כ' הרי הוא כמבושל preserved substances are in ritual law like cooked.—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּבוּשִׁין</plural-form>. Pes. II, 6. Y. Sabb. I, 3
<sup>c</sup> bot. כְּבוּשֵׁיהֶן preserves made by gentiles; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> Trnsf. 
<italic>to store, hide</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥag. 13
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Prov. XXVII, 26) א"ת כבשים אלא כְּבוּשִׁים Ms. M. (missing in ed.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) read not 
<italic>K’basim</italic> (sheep) but 
<italic>K’bushim</italic> (hidden things), v. כִּבְשָׁן; Yalk. Prov. 961.—Sot. 10
<sup>b</sup>; Macc. 23
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Gen. XXXVIII, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>5)</number>
<definition> יצאת … ממני יצאו כבושים a divine voice went forth and said, ‘from me went forth the secret things’ (I declare that Judah is the father of Tamar’s children; Ar.: ממני היו הדברים כ', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6); Yalk. Gen. 145; Yalk. I Sam. 112.</definition>
<notes>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6); Yalk. Gen. 145; Yalk. I Sam. 112.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to detain</italic> (cmp. עצר).</definition>
<notes> Pesik. Bayom, p. 193
<sup>b</sup>; כָּבְשָׁה אותם מטרונא וכ' the matron detained them one day longer; כבשה אותן התורה וכ' the Law detained them one day longer (before the Lord); ib. 195
<sup>a</sup>, sq.; Pesik. R. suppl., s. 4. Gen. R. s. 8, end האיש כּוֹבֵשׁ וכ' the man detains his wife from going out; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to suppress, restrain, conquer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. XI, 5 (89
<sup>a</sup>) הכּוֹבֵש את נבואתו (a prophet) who suppresses his prophecy (being afraid to proclaim it). Ab. IV, 1 הכיבש את יצרו who conquers his passion. Lam. R. to V, 1 כובש את הגדול (not כביש), v. זַרְזִיר I. Y. Succ. V, 55
<sup>b</sup> top עד שאתה מְכַבֵּשׁ … בוא וכְבוֹש וכ' instead of conquering the barbarians, come and subdue the Jews; Lam. R. to I, 16; ib. to IV, 19. Ex. R. s. 25 הוא כוֹבְשׁוֹ וכ' he suppresses (withholds the evidence) and does not produce it.—כ' עון 
<italic>to suppress guilt, to forgive, cause forgiveness</italic>. Pesik. Eth Korb., p. 61
<sup>b</sup>; Pesik. R. s. 16, v. כֶּבֶשׁ; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—7)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to violate</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—8)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pave, grade a road</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. כָּבוּשׁ, f. כְּבוּשָׁה. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 20 דרך כ' a graded road; ib. ed. Bub. 47; Yalk. Num. 764. [Pirké d’R. El. ch. LII כובשים במזלות, read with Yalk. Josh. 22: חושבים; Yalk. Gen. 77 רוגשים.]</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to press, squeeze</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. מְכוּבָּשׁ, pl. מְכוּבָּשִׁים. Tosef. Mikv. VI (VII), 17 לכלוכי צואה … המ' (ed. Zuck. והמכושים, corr. acc.) secretory substances … which are compressed, i.e. dried up by being sat upon.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. סָלַל II) 
<italic>to press down, make even, grade</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. IV, 5 מְכַבְּשִׁין you may press the ashes down (make a graded surface for baking); a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to level, make plain</italic>. Cant. R. to I, 2 (play on כבשים, Prov. XXVIII, 26, v. כֶּבֶשׁ) … כְּבָשִׁים … תהי' מְכַבֵּשׁ לפניהם וכ' it may be read 
<italic>K’bashim</italic> (
<italic>grades</italic>), as long as thy pupils are young, make the words of the Law plain before them; when they are older reveal to them the secrets (reasons) of the Law; Yalk. ib. 985 הֱיֵה כוֹבֵשׁ לפניהם (another expl., v. infra).—כ' את הריחיים [
<italic>to carve steps for the grain</italic>,] 
<italic>to put the millstones in working order</italic>. M. Kat. I, 9; expl. ib. 10
<sup>a</sup> to sharpen the millstones (v. נָקַר I), (oth. opin.) to cut the hole out for the hopper.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (interch. with 
<italic>Kal</italic>) 
<italic>to conquer, defeat</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah VII, 20
<sup>c</sup> top שבע שכִּיבְּשׁוּ seven years during which they were engaged in conquering the land; Ḥull. 17
<sup>a</sup> שכבשו. Sifré Deut. 51 לכַבֵּש ח"ל עד שלא יְכַבְּשׁוּ וכ' to conquer foreign land before they shall have conquered Palestine. Pes. 5
<sup>b</sup> נכרי שכִּיבַּשְׁתּוֹ a gentile who is in thy power. Yeb. 65
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to וכבשה, Gen. I, 28) איש דרכו לכַבֵּשׁ וכ' it is man who conquers (the earth) but not woman; Kidd. 35
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to suppress, withhold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. l. c. תהי' מכבש לפניהם וכ' withhold from them, i.e. teach them merely the words of the Law without arguments; (another expl., v. supra).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition> (denom. of כֶּבֶשׁ) 
<italic>to storm, climb over</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sot. VI, 6 מכבש את הגנות וכ' climbing over the garden fences and violating the women; Gen. R. s. 53; Yalk. Gen. 94 מַכְבִּישׁ 
<italic>Hif.</italic></notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִכְבַּשׁ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be pressed down, suppressed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. Eth. Korb. p. 61
<sup>b</sup> כל דבר שהוא נ' סופו לצוף whatever is pressed down, is liable to come to the surface again; Pesik. R. s. 16.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be submissive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. XXX, end when scholars sit down ונִכְבָּשִׁין אלו לאלו and are submissive (respectful) to one another; (Sabb. 63
<sup>a</sup> ונוחין).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to have surreptitious intercourse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra Emor, Par. 6, ch. V נ' עם; Yeb. VII, 5 נ' על.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִכְבִּישׁ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to climb</italic>, v. supra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְכַּבֵּשׁ, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְכַּבֵּשׁ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be conquered, be taken</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebi. VI, 36
<sup>c</sup> bot. כמי שנִתְכַּבְּשׁוּ they are to be treated as if they had been subdued (in the days of Joshua). Ib. שמא נִתְכַּבְּשָׁה מד"ת perhaps it was to be taken by the command of the Law; Y. Yeb. VII, 8
<sup>a</sup> bot. (corr. acc.). Ex. R. s. 18 עכשיו … מִתְכַּבֶּשֶׁת בידו just now Jerusalem may be taken by him (Sennacherib). [Pesik. Zutr., Ekeb, ed. Bub. p. 30 מתכבשים, מתכבשות, v. כָּתַשׁ.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00121">
<head-word>כְּדִי, </head-word>
<head-word> I, (, </head-word>
<head-word>כַּדִּי, </head-word>
<head-word>כְּדֵי)</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= כַּד הִי, v. 
<xref rid="K00112">כְּדוּ</xref>) 
<italic>when; now</italic> (
<italic>that</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 34. Ib. XXXIX, 10; a. e.—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40
<sup>d</sup> top כ' טבא when it (the eye-paint) is good. Y. Dem. VI, 25
<sup>c</sup> bot. כ' יהב ליה כ' when he gives him the whole of it. Y. Meg. III, 74
<sup>b</sup> bot. כ' דהוינן, v. כַּד I.—2) [
<italic>as it is</italic>,] 
<italic>incidentatly, without special reason, not meaning it exactly</italic>. R. Hash. 5
<sup>a</sup> פסח כ' נסבה the writer uses the word Pesaḥ (ib. 4
<sup>a</sup>, quot. fr. Tosef. Arakh. III, 17) incidentally (cmp. אַשְׁגָּרָה); Zeb. 99
<sup>b</sup>. Kidd. 5
<sup>b</sup> סיפא כ' נסבה the second proposition was incidentally asserted (is not to be pressed), opp. דַּוְקָא.—3.) 
<italic>as such, alone, merely</italic>. Keth. 36
<sup>b</sup> bot. מעיד בה כ' if he merely testifies in her favor (without having been instrumental in redeeming her from captivity). Gitt. 55
<sup>a</sup> יאוש כ' וכ' the mere giving up of robbed property (without a change of hands after the renunciation) gives the robber no rights. מילי דכ'־ 
<italic>words spoken merely for saying something, for fun</italic>. Snh. 29
<sup>b</sup> כל מילי דכ' וכ' people do not remember words thrown out in a jocular way.—[Bekh. 8
<sup>b</sup> מילי דכ' Ar. 
<italic>fictions, stories;</italic> v. כַּדְבָא).—בִּכְ' 
<italic>for whatever it be, for a trifle; for no cause</italic>. Yeb. 39
<sup>b</sup> בכ' תיפוק can she be dismissed without any formality (with his mere refusal to marry her)?—Taan. 5
<sup>b</sup>, v. בְּכָא. Keth. l. c. לא שדי … בכ' one does not throw away one’s money at random (unless sure that there is no legal impediment to marrying the woman whom he is about to redeem). Ned. 22
<sup>a</sup> בכ' לא אדרתה for a paltry reason she would surely not have forbidden her, v. נְדַר. Ib. 29
<sup>a</sup> פקעה בכ' ceases without any formality; a. e.—מִכְּ' 
<italic>from such</italic> (
<italic>a condition</italic>) 
<italic>as it is, now, well, you know</italic>. Gitt. 68
<sup>b</sup> מ' כי מיית וכ' now when you die, you will have &c. Sabb. 78
<sup>a</sup> מ' כל מילתא וכ' you know, whenever there is an ordinary and an extraordinary way of using an object, &c. Ḥull. 109
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.—Esp. (introducing an argument) 
<italic>now, is it not so?</italic> Ib. 29
<sup>a</sup> מ' על עיף קאי וכ' does not the writer of the Mishnah treat of birds? Well then, if he meant sacrificial fowls he ought to have said 
<italic>hammolek!</italic> B. Kam. 3
<sup>a</sup> מ' שקולין וכ' now that they are alike, let both be included, for which will you exclude?—Bets. 2
<sup>b</sup> מ' מאן סתמה וכ' now, who is it that states that proposition in the Mishnah anonymously? Of course, Rabbi. Now, why &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
